lookup_name: Gorilla gorilla gorilla; Gorilla gorilla; Gorilla sp.
lookup_basis: All 110 Gorilla sp. rows in __merging_volumes/volumes_long.csv record species_printed=Gorilla gorilla with species_basis=lump, and no row in that merge prints beringei, so 'sp.' is the volumes merge's conservative genus-level label for western gorilla material rather than a pooling of two gorilla species. G. g. gorilla is the nominate subspecies of G. gorilla and the only one present in research collections (G. g. diehli numbers a few hundred wild individuals). The trinomial is retained because 23 of its 30 variables occur under no other label, spanning 6 domains (life history 11, diet & ecology 4, behaviour & cognition 3, cellular composition 3, body size 1, brain structure & size 1). Adopting all three: 30 -> 249 measurement variables.
source: Project owner, list supplied 2026-09-30
note: pooled from 3 labels; the trinomial's 30 values are all Lewitus et al. 2014 (secondary compilation) and its Glia_neuron_ratio / Glial_cell_density / Neuronal_density are not yet source-audited

lookup_basis: The cohort's sequenced pig is a domestic animal, and species_printed is 'Sus scrofa domesticus' verbatim in volumes_long.csv, so the two labels denote different forms rather than one animal under two names: body mass 100,000 vs 65,091 g (35%), brain mass 137.65 vs 112 g (19%), cortical surface area 6,594 vs 13,022 mm2 (49%). Re-pointed rather than pooled, because pooling would report a mean body mass (~82 kg) describing neither animal and the app's plot tab is allometric by default. Owner decision 2026-09-30. 58 -> 107 measurement variables; gains the Kazu 2015 and Herculano-Houzel cell counts.
source: Project owner, list supplied 2026-09-30
